Date: 2021-11-05
REMARKS
By this Preliminary Amendment, original claims 1-59 of the above-identified International Application have been canceled without prejudice. New claims 60-79 have been added. No new matter has been added by virtue of the claim amendments. In particular, new claims 60-79 contain subject matter presented in original claims 1-18, 21-29, 32, 33, and 50-56 of the International Application as originally filed.
The specification has been amended to include a cross-reference to the related International Application and the U.S. Provisional Application to which the International Application claims priority.
In view of the above, the Applicant respectfully requests entry of this Preliminary Amendment.
Date: November 5, 2021 Respectfully submitted,/Frank DeRosa/Frank V. DeRosaAttorney for ApplicantReg. No. 43,584Ryan, Mason & Lewis, LLP48 South Service Road, Suite 100Melville, NY 11747Telephone: 631-393-6447 11
